subject: Urban Planning
title: Micromobility: Scooters and Small Vehicles
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Micromobility: Scooters and Small Vehicles.

hook.text: Electric scooters appeared overnight in cities worldwide. No one asked for permission. Chaos followed.

buildup.text: Micromobility covers trips under 5 miles — scooters, e-bikes, and small electric vehicles fill the gap transit can't.

discovery.text: In Paris, scooter trips replaced 30% of car rides under 3 km. The shift happened in just two years.

twist.text: Abandoned scooters block sidewalks and endanger pedestrians. Cities scrambled to regulate what they hadn't planned for.

climax.text: Paris banned rental scooters in 2023 by referendum. Other cities created docking zones and speed limits instead.

punchline.text: The scooters arrived before the rules. Cities are still catching up.

quiz.question: Why did Paris ban rental e-scooters in 2023?
options: E-scooter companies refused to pay city licensing fees
Citizens voted in a referendum to ban them due to safety and sidewalk concerns
A national law prohibited electric vehicles on city streets
